title: Jobs
description: A job is a unit of requested work with a goal. It owns zero or more graph executions over its life, at most one active at a time in this release. Job state is separate from execution state: cancelling an execution does not by itself end the job.

job_state.description: open: may progress (an execution is active, or the job holds waiting for one). paused: no new scheduling. completed / failed: the latest execution ended so, and no execution is active; steering with `if_completed: follow_up` reopens the job with a new execution. cancelled: permanently stopped by `jobs.cancel`; never resumed.

job_scope.description: Which jobs a job control affects. Descendants are included only when named explicitly.

goal.description: What the job is for, in plain language.

context.description: Caller-supplied, non-secret context for the job, such as the originating issue or pull request. At most 64 keys.

loop_id.description: The loop that created the job, if any.

active_execution_id.description: The execution currently running, paused or awaiting approval; null when none is.

ended_at.description: When the job entered completed, failed or cancelled.
